BiblicalUsage: Middle is a word of measurements and of courts. The middle chamber of the temple was six cubits broad, and Isaiah was still in the middle court when the word of the Lord came to him about Hezekiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word quietly maps sacred space: the temple had a middle, and the prophet stood in it when God spoke.
